Join us and help shape PtX (Power-to-X) and BtX (Bio-to-X) projects on a global scale, working with an experienced team on the solutions of the future.

At Blue Power Partners, we are a global consultancy and project development company dedicated to delivering renewable energy solutions that support sustainable change. Our core expertise is conceptual design and economic modeling of entire complexes, including wind and solar farms, power sourcing, and downstream PtX and BtX facilities.

We work closely with our clients, who include one of the world’s largest fund managers in greenfield renewable energy.

**About the job

**We are looking for an experienced Senior Process Engineer to contribute to the development of PtX and BtX facilities worldwide. You will join a team of skilled specialists in a role with a wide variety of tasks. The key deliverables are due diligence, feasibility analysis, and initial conceptual design.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading process development, including feasibility studies and pre-FEED, and sharing your process expertise as a technical advisor

• Working with our modeling team on techno-economic optimization by providing technical and economic input

• Taking part in technical classification meetings, exhibit reviews, and negotiations

• Supporting proposals, tender processes, safety assessments, and plant commissioning

• Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects

• Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders

• Managing third-party verification

• Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery

You will work from our office in Copenhagen (Tromsøgade 2, Nordhavn) or Aalborg HQ (John F. Kennedys Plads 43). Because we work globally, the role sometimes calls for flexibility, and we offer the same in return.

**About you

**You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter.

We are looking for someone who brings:

• An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field

• Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

• A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer

• Hands-on experience with one or more PtX or BtX production processes, such as electrolysis, steam methane reforming (SMR), Haber-Bosch, methanol synthesis, methanation, synthesis of higher hydrocarbons (SAF), refinery processes, biomass processing, carbon capture, or CO2 sequestration

• Good collaboration and organizational skills

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Contact

**For more information about the position, please contact Anne Krog Jensen, Head of PtX & Molecules, at akj@bluepp.dk.

To apply, upload your resume through our recruitment system via the “Apply” link. We don’t accept applications by email.

**Why join Blue Power Partners?

**At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Our organization is built on trust, entrepreneurship, and balance. You will join a focused team working on specialized technical projects, where you can grow your expertise in PtX and BtX. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.

Join us in this role where you’ll own the design and architecture of a new execution algorithm platform. You’ll combine hands-on Python development with technical leadership, bringing practical trading experience to build a robust, scalable, and low-latency foundation from scratch.

**Welcome to Algo Development

**You’ll be part of Algo Development where you, together with your colleagues, will build the shared algo platform used to deploy execution algorithms across multiple trading functions in Trading & Revenue, including power, gas and storage & flexibility. You’ll collaborate closely with trading desks, quantitative analysts, and platform specialists to create reliable solutions that can scale and deliver value across the business.

As a team, we share ideas openly, test our thinking, and support each other in creating solutions that deliver measurable value across the business.

You’ll play an important role in:

• owning and driving the platform architecture, technical design, and development roadmap

• building robust, scalable, and high-performance Python software for automated trading

• designing reusable components, API interfaces, event-driven flows, and data architecture

• leading design sessions and challenge technical assumptions using experience from trading environments

• aligning stakeholders across trading, analytics, data science, and platform teams

• establishing strong engineering practices for testing, reliability, monitoring, performance, and maintainability.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have deep Python software development expertise and a strong record of building production platforms

• bring experience from power, gas or commodity trading functions and understand how continuous markets and execution systems operate

• have designed or significantly shaped scalable, event-driven, or low-latency systems

• can own architecture decisions while remaining hands-on in design, coding, and delivery

• communicate complex ideas clearly, facilitate technical discussions, and constructively challenge stakeholders

• are motivated by building from scratch, creating commercial value, and helping others make strong technical decisions.

What we offer:

• the opportunity to build an algo trading platform from scratch

• opportunities for career growth with responsibility given from day one

• flexible hybrid working model

• flat hierarchy with high trust, autonomy and freedom to make decisions.

You will serve as a versatile contributor across customer, supplier, project and quality management areas. You will work closely with the local Quality teams in China, Europe and Mexico as well as with our Customer Quality Managers and report to the global head of SEN Quality COE.

At Danfoss, we believe quality is a key enabler of innovation and customer success. In this role, you'll help strengthen our global quality culture while supporting the growth of our Sensing Solutions business.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**What You'll Get From Us

**Shaping Our Ai Capabilities

**Are you motivated by building the platform that powers a company's AI ambitions, alongside a team of highly skilled and similarly motivated engineers? Then you may just be the perfect fit for our Cloud Platform team in STARK Group IT.

We are at the early stages of establishing an AI Center of Excellence in partnership with the CTO Office, and our Platform team is building the infrastructure capabilities needed to support it, from hosting AI agents to enabling on-prem AI workloads. This is an opportunity to help shape those capabilities as they evolve.

**The mission, should you choose to accept it

**As our new Senior Platform Engineer, you will join our existing cloud team, taking responsibility for applying modern cloud disciplines and technologies to design and implement the Cloud Platform used by more than 17 development teams and powering solutions for our 20,000 global employees. Increasingly, that also means helping shape how AI is used across the company - working hand in hand with the CTO's office as they build out the AI Center of Excellence, contributing to what "good" looks like for agentic usage, cost and credit management, agent scaling, and building the platform capabilities that make it all work in practice.

This isn't just an infrastructure role. You'll help define guidance and best practices alongside the CoE, as well as build the platform underneath it - a rare chance to shape both the standards and the systems from the ground up. You'll become part of a highly performant, international team that gives you plenty of freedom in how you work, along with responsibility to make your own impact.

Your work with us will primarily, but not exclusively, revolve around the following areas:

• Expand our Azure Cloud capabilities, leaning on IaC as your main tool and following the principles of the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.

• Build and operate the infrastructure for agentic AI workloads, including agent hosting, orchestration, and the platform capabilities needed to run them reliably at scale.

• Build toward a truly hybrid AI setup, pairing cloud-native AI capabilities with on-prem infrastructure so workloads can run wherever makes the most sense.

• Contribute to the guidance and standards coming out of the AI CoE, helping define what "good" looks like for agentic usage, credit and cost management, and agent scaling across the company.

• Strengthen and tune our Kubernetes workloads, making sure they run with the performance, resilience, and efficiency our business depends on.

• Drive a Platform Engineering approach to our cloud and AI infrastructure and tooling, working closely with Software Engineering teams and the AI CoE to build cohesive, developer-friendly experiences.

• Deliver on a modern, secure, and scalable cloud architecture, which you will help shape - one that's increasingly built with AI workloads in mind.

To succeed in this role, we are not just looking for someone who checks boxes - we're looking for someone honest, vocal, and unafraid to challenge the status quo when you see ways we can improve.

**Who are we looking for?

**So, if you enjoy spotting the glitches in the Matrix before anyone else does, or you’ve ever whispered "it's always DNS" to yourself (even when the culprit turned out to be a misbehaving agent), we consider that a positive sign.

Those qualities tend to go hand in hand with what we're looking for: someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, isn't afraid to challenge established ways of working, and combines technical depth with a pragmatic mindset, helping us build and evolve the platform capabilities that support both today's cloud services and tomorrow's AI ambitions.

The skills that will help you thrive include:

• A solid grasp of the Azure Cloud ecosystem, understanding both its opportunities and its boundaries.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code, ideally with Bicep, and the ability to bring structure, clarity, and repeatability to how we build cloud resources.

• Comfort with scripting, whether your tool of choice is Python, Bash, or PowerShell, to automate tasks and streamline operational workflows.

• Experience with Kubernetes fundamentals, including deployments, services, and scaling.

• Curiosity about or exposure to AI infrastructure concepts - things like model hosting, agent orchestration frameworks, or GPU-backed workloads - even if you're not an AI expert yet.

• General familiarity with CI/CD and networking, giving you a well-rounded foundation for how we do cloud engineering.

**Welcome to Group IT

**When joining Group IT, you will be joining a digital transformation journey as we replace our legacy systems and transition towards a modular and flexible integrated setup. Group IT, a dynamic and rapidly evolving part of STARK Group, is responsible for delivering groupwide business-critical IT solutions. We strive to modernize and reimagine the IT landscape to ensure both scalability and composability to meet existing and future business needs, and we would like your help to rethink the way things are done in our industry to offer our customers a superior experience.

**Want to know more and apply?

**We will be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your options in STARK Group. You are welcome to contact Magnus Bech Larsen, magnus.larsen@stark.dk for any specific questions regarding the role.

**Role

**The Senior Manager, Inspection Readiness - Good Clinical Practice, plays a key role in supporting the Clinical Trial Operations organization by embedding clinical compliance and inspection readiness into clinical trials and service provider oversight. This position is essential for maintaining a high level of clinical trial inspection readiness while ensuring adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. The individual will also lead process improvement initiatives.

This is an individual contributor role at the Senior Manager level, reporting to the Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead.

**Responsibilities

****Trial Inspection Readiness and Preparation

**

• Design and optimize tools and processes for trial inspection readiness, leveraging digitalization and automation to improve efficiency and compliance.

• Guide study teams in maintaining trial inspection readiness by providing GCP and clinical compliance support, including risk identification, mitigation and monitoring; management of serious GCP breaches and other reportable or non-reportable persistent non-compliance events; and follow-up and closure of quality events, thereby strengthening sponsor oversight.

• Conduct ongoing assessments of compound and/or trial inspection readiness by analyzing key metrics to generate actionable insights.

• Lead the development and delivery of GCP inspection readiness training and tools for Clinical Trial Operations and other key stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with GCP QA to support the operational framework and inspection setup during sponsor, site and vendor GCP inspections.

• Facilitate lessons-learned activities based on inspection readiness assessments, preparations and outcomes within Clinical Trial Operations.

**Quality Events Oversight

**

• Maintain oversight of Clinical Trial Delivery quality events and effectiveness checks, ensuring compliance with applicable requirements.

• Analyze trends in findings from audits, inspections and quality events, as relevant to Clinical Trial Operations and other key stakeholders.

**Clinical Compliance

**

• Provide guidance and support on ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA and NMPA) and Genmab SOPs.

• Lead and contribute to functional and/or cross-functional business process improvements, system enhancements and innovative initiatives.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s (BSc) or master’s degree (MSc) in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine or a related discipline.

• A minimum of 8 years of experience in Clinical Operations, Clinical Quality, Inspection Readiness or Clinical Compliance within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and the clinical drug development lifecycle.

• Strong project management skills and knowledge of relevant tools and processes.

• Experience mentoring colleagues and supporting their professional development.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to proactively identify risks, develop mitigation strategies and effectively resolve issues.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions in a complex, global, matrix organization.

Develop advanced power electronics for high-performance laser systems

Do you want to work hands-on with power electronics in a highly specialized R&D environment, developing solutions used in advanced laser and photonics technologies?

Hamamatsu Photonics A/S is expanding its R&D organization and is looking for a Senior Power Electronics Engineer to strengthen its electronics capabilities.

About the Company

Hamamatsu Photonics is a global leader in photonics, laser and fibre technologies, employing more than 5,800 people worldwide.

Following the acquisition of NKT Photonics in 2024, the former NKT Photonics organisation now operates as the Lasers & Fibers Business Unit within the Hamamatsu Photonics Group, supporting applications within Quantum Technologies, Life Sciences, Semiconductors, Aerospace & Defence and Advanced Industrial Technologies.

Responsibilities

As Senior Power Electronics Engineer, you will take ownership of electronics development across the full product lifecycle—from early concept and design to validation, production, and optimization.

You will work in a multidisciplinary R&D environment, contributing to both detailed design and system-level solutions. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role with high ownership.

The role is based in Birkerød, Denmark and reports to the Team Lead Electronics.

Key responsibilities:

• Design and develop power electronics for laser systems across the full product lifecycle

• Own technical work packages and ensure delivery within scope, timeline, and quality targets

• Develop system-level electronics architectures and design concepts

• Collaborate closely with experts in optics, mechanics, and system design

• Create reference designs to support scalability and standardization

• Support manufacturing, custom solutions, and product improvements

• Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and certification requirements

What you will be doing (in practice)

• Working on low-volume, high-margin, high-complexity systems

• Translating unclear or evolving customer requirements into robust technical solutions

• Contributing to both detailed circuit design and overall system performance

• Taking ownership of solutions from idea → design → validation → production

Profile

You are a strong power electronics specialist with experience developing complex systems and a structured, solution-oriented mindset.

Experience

• Senior-level experience in power electronics development (100W–10kW range)

• Strong track record in PCB design and product development

• Experience working across the full product lifecycle

• Comfortable working in complex and evolving R&D environments

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders

Technical expertise

You have strong experience in several of the following:

Power electronics design

• DC/DC converter design and verification (kW range)

• Analog circuit design (control loops, amplifiers, inrush circuits)

Hardware & components

• Magnetic component design (inductors, transformers, chokes)

• PCB design and productization

Simulation & analysis

• Circuit simulation (e.g. LTspice, Pspice)

• Worst-case analysis, component stress, MTBF, DFMEA

General

• Strong understanding of switch-mode power electronics technologies

• Experience working with external partners or suppliers

Hamamatsu Photonics offers a highly innovative and collaborative working environment where you can influence both technology and product development while being part of a globally recognized photonics organization.

**In this Staff Software Engineering role, you’ll be…

**

**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

About Portchain

Portchain exists to make maritime shipping more predictable, efficient, and green. We help shipping companies and terminals coordinate around shared, trustworthy information to reduce delays, fuel consumption, and emissions.

Our products support some of the world’s largest shipping companies, with more than 200 terminals connected through the Portchain Network.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep backend experience in Node.js and TypeScript.

You’ll build services, APIs, and integrations that power carrier and terminal workflows, berth planning, and new products. Working closely with Product, you’ll turn customer problems into simple, scalable solutions and own your work from design through production.

Our stack includes Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Google Cloud, with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Datadog.

How we work

Product teams of four or more engineers, each supported by a dedicated Product Manager, but with overlap between teams when needed.

We care about craftsmanship: understandable code, trustworthy high quality data, thoughtful user experiences, and systems that remain reliable and maintainable. We balance that care with pragmatic decisions and still deploy 10+ per day.

Curiosity matters here. We ask questions, explore customer problems, challenge assumptions, and learn from each other and from mistakes without blame.

How we use AI

AI is a core part of our engineering workflow. We use it for exploration, implementation, review, and technical sparring, and share useful practices with the team. We move faster than any of our customers, but not at the expense of quality or engineering understanding of behavior.

The final judgment remains with the engineer. We expect you to understand, review, validate, and be able to defend the code and decisions you ship, while protecting customer and company data.

What we’re looking for

• Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems with Node.js and TypeScript, including asynchronous execution, error handling, and diagnosing production issues.

• Strong relational database skills: schema design, SQL, transactions, and query performance. We use PostgreSQL.

• Experience designing robust APIs and integrating systems with different data formats and reliability characteristics.

• Experience deploying and operating software on GCP, AWS, Azure, or a similar cloud platform. We use GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL etc.)

• Sound architectural judgment, pride in your craft, and the ability to turn loosely defined problems into pragmatic solutions.

• Curiosity about unfamiliar domains and technologies, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to end-to-end ownership.

Useful extras include

GCP/Cloud Run, Terraform, CI/CD and observability, complex data ingestion, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 experience, and breadth across languages or technical side projects.

What we offer

• Meaningful work with global economic and environmental impact.

• Influence over products, architecture, and ways of working.

• Experienced, curious, and supportive colleagues.

• Competitive compensation and pension.

• Flexible working hours in our Copenhagen office.

• Subsidized lunch, snacks, and drinks.

• A dedicated development budget and support for continued learning.

If the role sounds exciting and you believe you can contribute, we would like to hear from you.

What Makes Us, Us  Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Accounting team is growing and we are looking for more team members to join. If you are curious, collaborative and enjoy taking initiative this could be a great place to work. You do not need to have all answers from day one. What matters to us is that you are open to learning, willing to try and comfortable to step into new challenges.

At SimCorp, we support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Accounting is a unit within SimCorp’s Product Division which delivers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Develop and maintain features in the Accounting product areas.

• Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.

• Collaborate closely with teammates, Product Managers, and Architects to deliver high-quality and secure solutions.

• Create, document and maintain test cases and automated tests to cover the features’ acceptance criteria (system, integration, unit etc.)

• Uphold engineering best practices and contribute to continuous improvement.

• Learn deeply about our Accounting domain and understand how our products support customer outcomes.

• Experience working with relational databases and SQL.

• Readiness to work in a complex accounting domain, dealing with financial and investment-related instruments.

• Good English skills (upper-intermediate or higher), both written and spoken.

• Experience with cloud technologies and fintech domain is a plus.

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.** At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Are you interested in sustainability, enjoy working with data, and want to turn reporting requirements into practical action? Join Flatpay and help build the foundations of our ESG work across multiple markets!

We’re looking for a curious, structured colleague who enjoys digging into details, connecting with people, and bringing order to complex information.

**About Flatpay

**Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,500 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

**What You'll Do

**You’ll coordinate ESG data collection and reporting across our markets, working with internal teams, suppliers, and external compliance partners. This is a hands-on role with international exposure and room to develop. You’ll help shape Flatpay’s ESG function from the ground up, taking increasing ownership as your knowledge and experience grow.

• Coordinate ESG reporting across markets. Organize data collection, follow up on inputs, and support accurate, timely reporting, including CSRD-related work where applicable.

• Work across teams and borders. Collaborate with colleagues, suppliers, and external compliance partners to make reporting processes clear and manageable.

• Track relevant requirements. Help assess what developments in CSRD, the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), and local producer responsibility schemes mean for Flatpay.

• Coordinate producer responsibility reporting. Work with Dansk Producentansvar (DPA), equivalent organisations in other markets, and relevant compliance partners.

• Support practical sustainability initiatives. Contribute to improvements in reverse logistics, refurbishment, and how we manage products throughout their lifecycle.

• Help establish our ESG function. Build processes, improve data quality, and gradually become an internal point of contact for sustainability reporting and compliance questions.

**Who You Are

**

• An interest in ESG and sustainability, particularly the data and reporting behind them.

• An analytical mindset and confidence working with spreadsheets and structured data.

• A careful, organised approach: you spot inconsistencies, ask questions, and follow through.

• The ability to work with colleagues and suppliers to get the information you need.

• Curiosity about regulations and the ability to translate complex information into clear next steps.

• Strong communication skills in English and an interest in working across international markets.

Familiarity with CSRD or producer responsibility is welcome, but you don’t need to arrive as an expert in every framework.

**Why Flatpay

**Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build practical ESG experience across multiple markets and see the direct impact of your work. Your ideas will help shape our processes, strengthen our reporting, and inform how we approach sustainability as we scale.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Iryna Gomon

• Design, develop and maintain backend functionality and APIs using C# and .NET, and work with Dyalog APL where it is part of the product
